title: Okayama Prefecture Tourism — Korakuen Garden

facts.fact: Garden was created by the second Okayama lord Ikeda Tsunamasa, with seasonal planting and Edo-period landscape heritage.
The garden was designated a Special Place of Scenic Beauty in1952; rankings and Michelin claims are not reproduced.
Seasonal flowers and autumn colours vary; no bloom or illumination is guaranteed for a reader date.
